The verbatim excerpt was extracted PROGRAMMATICALLY from the raw HTML bytes (the field--name-body container): defined terms (bold-italic <strong><em>) written #term#; ordered-list items prefixed with the label the print/PDF render prints ((a),(b) for the outer list; (1),(2) for a nested list; (i),(ii) for a third level); runs of whitespace and non-breaking spaces collapsed to one space and each block trimmed; embedded figures omitted. verbatim_excerpt:
23-23 Special Floor Area Provisions for Multiple Dwelling Residences

R1 R2 R3 R4 R5 R6 R7 R8 R9 R10 R11 R12

In the districts indicated, for #buildings# containing #multiple dwelling residences#, floor space allocated to #building# amenities, corridors, refuse storage or disposal, or access to elevated ground floor #dwelling units# may be exempted from the definition of #floor area# pursuant to Section 12-10, provided that the provisions of this Section, inclusive, are met. However, exempted floor space shall be considered #floor area# for the purposes of satisfying other #ground floor level# #use# regulations of this Resolution, including, but not limited to, limitations on #floor area# for certain #uses#, parking wrap and screening requirements, and requirements for #floor area# at the #ground floor level#.

Such provisions may be applied to #buildings# #developed# after December 5, 2024, and to existing #buildings# where, after December 5, 2024, an #enlargement#, #extension#, #conversion# or other alteration results in newly created or altered floor space that conforms with such specific provisions of this Section, inclusive.
verbatim_excerpt_composition: Verbatim blocks joined by a blank line, in page order: [0] the displayed section number and title; then each body paragraph and list item. A list item is written with the label the print/PDF render prints in front of it ((a),(b) outer; (1),(2) nested; (i),(ii) third level), followed by one space; an item's heading line and its text (a double line break in the HTML) are separate blocks. Defined terms (bold-italic in the HTML) are written #term#. Runs of whitespace and non-breaking spaces are written as one space and each block is trimmed; no word was changed. The structured labels were confirmed against the print/PDF render (cross_check: match).
notes: Captured as source text only for the R6B checks / measurement-basis work order (task M4-T025, D-090 R400/R403; discovery DB-156). The capture holds the official section text and its provenance; it encodes no rule, no reading of the text for any lot, and no derived number.

The print/PDF render (cross_check) prints the whole 23-23 family; this capture holds only this section's own body text, which equals the corresponding portion of that PDF character-for-character.
